IS 16126 : 2013 : Textiles - Waterproof Tarpaulins made from Polyester Fabric - Specification13.340.99; 59.060.20; 59.080.30TXD 33Reaffirmed 20221 SCOPEThis standard specifies constructional, performance and functional requirements of two varieties of water resistant and rot resistant tarpaulins made from polyester fabric, bleached and/or dope dyed based on end use application and mass per unit area that is light and medium varieties2 REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
